status: PROSPECTIVE for future multilingual spelling Score execution; retrospective disclosure for already executed multilingual grammar Score
historical_limits: The multilingual grammar Score run already executed under the Choice-only neutral_multilingual_route_protocol.json. It was not prospectively authorized as a Score route by that follow-up. Preserve its artifacts as exploratory development evidence, never retroactively preregister it.

Ordinal v1 verification checked target fields but trusted arm-derived expected_level and error fields, and accepted missing or duplicate rows. Preserve original receipts; v2 reconstructs metrics from persisted probabilities and verified native targets.

Choice ECE used gold-label probability, and its Vey correctness expression compared a probability with the answer string. Supersede those ECE values without altering accuracy, NLL, Brier, predictions or paired accuracy statistics.

The earlier Score report inferred a rubric-prior mechanism and absence of training exposure without supporting interventions or provenance. Those claims are withdrawn. A rounded target histogram was incorrectly described as exact level-four prevalence.

prospective_execution.phase: dev only through guarded native projection; no train, calibration, confirmation or unused phase access
prospective_execution.route_rule: Report both pinned English and multilingual routes separately. Do not pick a winner to overwrite the registered English reference cell. No typed-decisions substitution.
prospective_execution.inputs: Identical source-native question, state, rubric order and target membership. Model-specific tokenization and published truncation remain route-specific and are disclosed.
prospective_execution.temperature: Use each route's own pinned config and bundle temp_bucket helper. No temperature fitting.
metrics: retained-rater NLL and Brier only with at least three raters
prospective_execution.integrity: Complete unique membership, immutable native input/target equality, finite normalized probabilities, independent expectation/error reconstruction and file hashes. Eight-decimal probability serialization permits 1e-6 normalization/derived-error tolerance; retain probabilities as saved.
prospective_execution.controls: Exercise fail-closed missing, duplicate, serving-input and invalid-probability cases with temporary fixtures; no model rerun needed for metric corrections. Preserve original receipts. Determinism and paired interval gates not exercised remain explicitly incomplete.
prospective_execution.selection: No training, route tuning, promotion, final-pool access or endgame completion. Choice accuracy remains the original primary endpoint. All Score metrics remain secondary.
prospective_execution.resources: One GPU process at a time under /tmp/vey-gpu.lock, at most four CPU threads and one BLAS thread, no paid calls.
